description: Makes the ender eye glow so you don't lose track of it!

mods.name: EnderEyeGlow
mods.description:
This mod makes Eyes of Ender glow whenever you throw them! It will also apply a custom color if you install ColoredGlowLib mod as well. 
 Originally suggested on the Fabric discord server by @shadow_tech and @hero_____________462
